description: Search the FrameThrower cinematography reference library by concept, mood, color, composition, or scene. Returns reference frames with film/credits metadata, a preview image and a link to view on FrameThrower. For the full-resolution file or the precomputed depth map, call get_frame_image with the frame id.

enhance.description: Smart search, on by default: rewrites short queries ("bear") into the descriptive language the frames were indexed with, like the website. Set false to search the exact text.

query.description: Natural-language description, e.g. "neon-lit rainy street at night"

name: search_frames
